description: Phase 3 (#55) v0.4.0 evaluation corpus. Seventeen fixtures: the 15-fixture (workstream x fixture_class) matrix from v0.3.0 (#55a) + the 2 safety counter fixtures from v0.3.1 (#55b). v0.4.0 adds baseline scoring (#55c): the runner aggregates `expected.metric_input` rows across the corpus, scores the totals against the manifest's declared thresholds, fails the run when a threshold is missed, and writes the measured numbers into `report.json` / `report.md`. The three v0.4.0 baselines are distillation_supported_claim_rate, distillation_hallucination_rejection_rate and bootstrap_hash_byte_determinism; the canonical happy fixtures (`distill_happy_v1`, `distill_no_hallucination_v1`, `bootstrap_scan_idempotent_v1`) declare the `metric_input` rows that drive the roll-up.
